source: Murata public PIM API (pimapi.murata.com/public/api/pim/v1), the data behind SimSurfing
note: c_v_25c: C(V) at 25 C (uF); temp_factor: [V_bias, [[T_C, C(V,T)/C(V,25 C)]]] from the C-temperature charts at bias (nearest charted bias; EIA class limit at 105 C where Murata has no chart); esr_f: [V_bias, [[f_Hz, R_ohm]]] at 25 C, 10 kHz-300 MHz. Same format as HVR_capacitor_vendor_data.json.

GRM21BZ71E106KE15.temp_factor_basis: EIA class limit (X7R: x0.85 at 85-125 C), no Murata chart
